notes.title: Year 2 Anniversary Sale and v1.02 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
We shipped out Forgotten Hope to Steam back in 2021 and the last two years has nothing but been amazing. 

To celebrate this milestone, Forgotten Hope is available 65% off from Steam until 15th May. 

In the meantime, we have added full controller support to the game and now you can leave your keyboard and mouse behind and enjoy Forgotten Hope with your favorite controller. 

We poured our hearts and souls in to Forgotten Hope, but we could not come this far without your support. So, thank you everyone who bought our game and leaving us with reviews. Whether good or bad, we value your feedback. And we hope that everyone who played our little game found the courage to move forward and never to give up. ~ Black Hammer Studios 🇱🇰



v1.02 Patch Notes


 Added full controller support.
 Optimized menus for better visibility. 
 Additional bug fixes



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40251691/d473cb1bd543f6c8e39f95b7716b5a2cc6f32f0b.png


Known Issues:

When scrolling through the available resolutions drop down menu using a controller, the drop-down menu will visibly glitch however, the correct resolution can be selected and applied without any problems.


If you come across any bugs or like to submit feedback to us, you can do so via our dedicated  subreddit

notes.title: Forgotten Hope v1.01 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where the beginning of each memory point shows a frame from the previously triggered memory point. 
    Added a volume slider to adjust/ disable the player's voice.
    Added few missing subtitle boxes for on-screen text. 
    Changed subtitles font for other characters
    Minor environmental changes



Submit your bugs and feedback to our dedicated  subreddit
